create_reporter_base: create a ReporterBase subclass that logs training metrics using value list and aggregating observers
log_training_metrics: call the log method on ReporterBase to notify observers with keyword argument training metrics
flush_aggregating_observers: call flush on ReporterBase at epoch end to flush all aggregating observers and log epoch completion
generate_training_report: implement the abstract generate_training_report method in a ReporterBase subclass to return a TrainingReport
access_observer_by_name: access a value list observer or aggregator by attribute name on ReporterBase using dot notation
